data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation is a process-trace reduction, but the reduction fails to be substantive: 'genuine reasoners invoke rules they later reject' is empirically indistinguishable from noisy or shotgun-style checklist invocation. A mere complier who invokes many rules probabilistically (to appear thorough) and then follows only a subset will produce the identical invocation-rate signature. The reduction thus lacks a discriminating mechanism and collapses the distinction it claims to diagnose.
